purpose: Persist the reviewed Advanced Search Service Request disappearance/reappearance warning lifecycle without treating source absence as ticket lifecycle authority or copying LLD-04 source rows into Tickets.

tables.name: sr_source_presence_events
columns: service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('disappearance_reviewed','reappearance_confirmed'))
prior_presence_event_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_presence_events(sr_source_presence_event_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
accepted_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK((event_kind='disappearance_reviewed' AND source_observation_id IS NULL AND prior_source_observation_id IS NOT NULL AND reconciliation_proposal_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_kind='reappearance_confirmed' AND source_observation_id IS NOT NULL AND prior_source_observation_id IS NULL AND reconciliation_proposal_id IS NULL))
rules: events are immutable append-only LLD-03 authority; no mutable warning/status row exists
no event history means no reviewed-disappearance warning; it does not independently assert that the SR is currently present in an external source
the unique chain root is the first reviewed disappearance for one service_request_id/source_family; every later event references the immediately prior chain head

event kinds alternate: a reappearance_confirmed follows the exact open disappearance_reviewed event it resolves, and a later disappearance_reviewed follows the exact prior reappearance_confirmed event
the current chain head is the unique event not referenced as prior_presence_event_id; disappearance_reviewed means warning open and reappearance_confirmed means warning clear
disappearance_reviewed is created only by accepted sr_source_disappearance_review through ServiceRequestImportMutationService after exact LLD-04 population-absence validation
reappearance_confirmed is created only inside governed PublishStagedImportRun after exact LLD-04 evidence proves the same canonical SR is present again in the same source family

import_run_id, source_observation_id, prior_source_observation_id and reconciliation_proposal_id are immutable opaque LLD-04 identities validated through SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider; this LLD-03 table has no physical FK into LLD-04 private tables

reappearance proves source presence only; it accepts no source field value and mutates no SR identity, lifecycle, source projection, Customer, Contact, Current Handler, RFC relationship or other ticket authority
field-level warnings or unusable non-identity fields do not prevent reappearance when the source observation itself has a valid conflict-free canonical eight-digit SR identity

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_sr_source_presence_chain_root ON sr_source_presence_events(service_request_id,source_family) WHERE prior_presence_event_id IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_sr_source_presence_successor ON sr_source_presence_events(prior_presence_event_id) WHERE prior_presence_event_id IS NOT NULL
database_guards: BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE reject every sr_source_presence_events row
BEFORE INSERT with prior_presence_event_id verifies the prior row belongs to the same service_request_id/source_family and has the opposite event_kind required by the alternating lifecycle

the chain-root and successor unique indexes prevent a second independent root or branch from one prior event; application revalidation additionally requires prior_presence_event_id to be the current chain head
LLD-03 validates every opaque LLD-04 evidence identity through SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider inside the authoritative caller UnitOfWork; no trigger queries LLD-04 private tables

current_projection.algorithm: read the unique chain head for service_request_id/source_family by selecting the event with no successor; no materialized current-warning table is required
current_projection.warning_rule: head event_kind=disappearance_reviewed emits exactly SR_SOURCE_DISAPPEARANCE_REVIEWED; head event_kind=reappearance_confirmed or no history emits no source-disappearance warning
current_projection.history_rule: all earlier cycles remain immutable and queryable independently of current warning projection

privacy_storage: Only bounded owner/evidence identifiers and event kind/time persist. Raw workbook rows, labels, field values, parser findings and source text never enter this table.
